versions.name: Camp Kanza
versions.summary: Quivira Council's Cub Scout and Webelos resident summer camp near Abbyville, Kansas.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by a parent 2026-08-13 (submission peJjNV1), credited to u/evdepov. Confirmed sold to the Diocese of Wichita, now the Father Emil J. Kapaun Family and Youth Camp.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/198-32972); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp.
